message.content: Add a dark mode toggle in the header. It should follow the system setting until someone picks, then remember their choice.

content.thinking: Three states, not two: system, light, dark. Store only an explicit pick in localStorage; with no pick, follow prefers-color-scheme. Set data-theme on <html> so CSS variables switch.

content.content: The file src/theme.ts has been updated.

content.text: Added `ThemeToggle`. With no saved choice it follows the system setting; clicking saves an explicit light or dark choice in localStorage and sets `data-theme` on the root element.
